recipes.name: Espresso Shot
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a warm espresso cup under the spout and press START BREW.
tips: Use the Single basket for a single shot or the Luxe basket for a quad.
New beans can take 2 or 3 shots before Barista Assist settles on the right grind.
recipes.blurb: A short, strong shot of coffee with a layer of golden crema on top. The base of almost every café drink.

recipes.name: Latte
ingredients: Milk of your choice, up to the LATTE line on the jug
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a large mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour milk up to the LATTE line into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY (or PLANT-BASED) lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the milk into the espresso, finishing with a thin layer of foam.
tips: You can start frothing while the shot brews: set the froth options during brewing and press START FROTH, and it begins as soon as the shot ends.
recipes.blurb: Espresso topped with plenty of steamed milk and a thin layer of foam. Smooth, mild and creamy.

steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.

Spoon the thick foam over the espresso, then dust with cocoa powder.
recipes.blurb: Espresso with equal parts steamed milk and thick, airy foam, finished with a dusting of cocoa.

recipes.name: Flat White
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place an 8 oz cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour 5 oz cold whole milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the silky milk into the espresso in one steady stream.
recipes.blurb: An Australian favorite: a double espresso with a little velvety steamed milk, so the coffee stays bold.

steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.

recipes.blurb: A shot of espresso "marked" with a spoonful of milk foam. Small and strong.

Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a small glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour milk up to the minimum fill line into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.

tips: Use the Single basket for a smaller, gentler cortado.
recipes.blurb: Espresso cut with an equal splash of warm steamed milk to soften the edges. Small and balanced.

Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Add the vanilla syrup to an 8 oz cup.
Place the cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour 5 oz cold whole milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the frothed milk over the espresso.
recipes.blurb: A classic cappuccino sweetened with vanilla syrup under a thick cap of foam.

recipes.name: Caramel Macchiato

steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Add the caramel syrup to a 6 oz cup.
Place the cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour 2 oz cold whole milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the frothed milk over the espresso and finish with a caramel drizzle.
tips: Make it iced: choose COLD-PRESSED, froth with COLD FOAM, and brew over ice.
recipes.blurb: Vanilla-sweet steamed milk with espresso poured on top and a crisscross of caramel drizzle.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Latte with Honey

steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Sprinkle the ½ tsp cinnamon over the grounds.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Add the honey to a 12 oz cup, place it under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir to melt the honey into the espresso.
Pour 8 oz cold whole milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the milk into the cup and dust with a little cinnamon.
recipes.blurb: A latte sweetened with honey and warmed up with cinnamon, dusted with more cinnamon on top.

Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.

Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the chocolate froth over the espresso.
recipes.blurb: Espresso and chocolate, topped with milk frothed with hot chocolate mix. Like a coffee and a hot cocoa in one.

Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.

Place a large mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour milk up to the LATTE line into the milk jug, then add the chai powder. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the spiced milk over the espresso.
recipes.blurb: A spiced chai latte with a shot of espresso added. Also called a dirty chai.

recipes.name: Affogato
steps: Scoop the ice cream into a small bowl or glass and keep it in the freezer while you brew.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place an espresso cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the hot espresso over the ice cream and serve right away.
recipes.blurb: An Italian dessert: a scoop of vanilla ice cream "drowned" in a hot shot of espresso.

recipes.name: Spanish Latte
ingredients: 1½ tbsp sweetened condensed milk (adjust to taste)
steps: Warm the glass with hot water from the hot water spout, then empty it.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Spoon the condensed milk into the warm glass.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir until the condensed milk melts into the espresso.
Pour 3 oz cold whole milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to STEAMED MILK and press START FROTH.
Top the glass with the hot milk and drink right away.
tips: Make it iced: stir the condensed milk into the espresso, pour over ice and top with cold milk in equal parts to the coffee.
For a foam top, use THIN FROTH instead of STEAMED MILK.
recipes.adaptation: The original uses three 30 ml shots and heats the milk in a pan to 181°F. We use the Pro's double shot and the STEAMED MILK preset.
recipes.blurb: Espresso sweetened with condensed milk and topped with steamed milk. Rich, creamy and caramel-sweet.

recipes.name: Café Bombón
steps: Pour the condensed milk into the bottom of a small clear glass.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a small pitcher or cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour 2 oz cold milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Slowly pour the espresso over the back of a spoon onto the condensed milk so the layers stay separate.
Spoon about 2 tbsp of the foam on top.
tips: Stir before drinking, or sip the layers one at a time.
recipes.adaptation: Brewed into a small pitcher first so it can be poured gently and keep the layers.
recipes.blurb: A Spanish layered drink: sweetened condensed milk at the bottom, espresso on top and a little milk.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Spice Latte
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Add the pumpkin spice syrup to a large mug.
Place the mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir the syrup into the espresso.
Pour 1 cup cold whole milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Fill the mug about ¾ full with the frothed milk.
Top with whipped cream and a pinch of pumpkin pie spice.
recipes.adaptation: The original froths the milk in a Nespresso Aeroccino. THIN FROTH gives the same latte texture.

subRecipes.name: Pumpkin spice syrup
steps: Bring the sugar and water to a simmer in a saucepan.
Once the sugar dissolves, add the cinnamon sticks, cloves, ginger, nutmeg and pumpkin purée and simmer for 20 minutes.
Take it off the heat and strain right away through cheesecloth. Keep it in the fridge.

recipes.blurb: The fall classic: espresso and steamed milk with homemade pumpkin spice syrup, whipped cream and spice.

recipes.name: Einspänner (Viennese Coffee)
ingredients: ⅓ cup (80 ml) cold heavy cream
About 1 tsp powdered or vanilla sugar (optional)
steps: Whip the cold cream and sugar with a mixer until just a little stiffer than soft peaks. Stop before it gets stiff.
Warm the glass with hot water from the hot water spout, then empty it.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place the warm glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir in 2 tbsp hot water if you'd like it a little longer.
Pour the cream gently over the back of a spoon held just above the coffee to build a thick white layer.
Finish with chocolate shavings or cocoa and serve right away.
tips: Fiaker variation: stir 1 oz kirsch into the espresso before the cream.
Cream that's too thin sinks; too stiff loses its silkiness.
recipes.blurb: A Viennese coffee: strong espresso under a thick cap of cold whipped cream, sipped through the cream.

recipes.name: Piccolo Latte
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RISTRETTO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a small 3 oz glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour 3½ oz cold milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Gently swirl the shot, then pour the milk to the top of the glass, leaving about ½ inch of foam at the rim.
tips: Tilt the glass and pour slowly if you want to try latte art.
recipes.blurb: A tiny latte: a ristretto shot topped with a little silky steamed milk in a small glass.

recipes.name: Melbourne Magic
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RISTRETTO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a 160 ml (5.4 oz) cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour cold milk, about 4 oz into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY (or PLANT-BASED) lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Gently pour the silky milk into the ristretto and let them blend. Aim for a flat-white texture with very little foam.
tips: Iced Magic: brew the ristretto, let it cool, pour over ice and add cold milk.
Magic Mocha: stir 1 tsp cocoa or chocolate syrup into the ristretto before the milk.
Flavored Magic: add vanilla, caramel or hazelnut syrup before the milk.
recipes.adaptation: Lavazza doses 18 to 20 g; the Pro's Double basket doses about 18 g by weight automatically.
recipes.blurb: A Melbourne café drink: a double ristretto with a small pour of silky milk. Sweet, strong and smooth.

recipes.name: Ristretto Over Ice
ingredients: A few thin slices of fresh ginger (optional)
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RISTRETTO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Put 3 ice cubes in a short glass.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the cold water over the ice and coffee.
Add a few slices of fresh ginger if you like.
recipes.blurb: A short, sweet ristretto poured over ice and a little cold water, with optional fresh ginger.

recipes.name: Thyme & Dark Chocolate Macchiato
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RISTRETTO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place an espresso cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour 3½ oz cold low-fat milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Spoon the hot foam over the ristretto.
Scatter a few thyme leaves on the foam and grate dark chocolate over the top.
recipes.adaptation: Nespresso's version uses a 25 ml capsule and the Aeroccino cappuccino setting. THICK FROTH is the Pro's cappuccino foam.
recipes.blurb: A ristretto macchiato with frothed milk, fresh thyme and grated dark chocolate. Herbal and chocolatey.

recipes.name: Iced Lungo
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to LUNGO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Put 3 ice cubes and the sugar (if using) in a cocktail shaker.
Place the shaker under the spout and press START BREW.
Put the lid on and shake hard for about 10 seconds until frothy.
Pour into a tall glass.
recipes.adaptation: Nespresso mixes 40 ml espresso with 100 ml cold water. The Pro's Double LUNGO brews that same longer volume in one go, so it goes straight onto the ice.
recipes.blurb: A long espresso shot poured straight over ice, lightly sweetened if you like.

recipes.name: Iced Lungo Macchiato
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to LUNGO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir in the brown sugar.
Pour cold milk up to the minimum fill line into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the lungo into a tall glass and add 4 to 5 tbsp crushed ice.
Spoon 3 to 4 tbsp of the milk foam on top.
Dust with chocolate powder if you like.
recipes.blurb: A lungo over crushed ice with brown sugar, topped with milk foam and a little chocolate powder.

recipes.name: Blueberry Lungo
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to LUNGO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Spoon the blueberry jam into the bottom of a clear cup.
Place the cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir before drinking, or let the jam sweeten the last sips.
recipes.adaptation: Created by Nespresso mixologist Sacha Wittorski. A dark, bold roast works best.
recipes.blurb: A long espresso shot stirred into a spoonful of blueberry jam. Fruity, bright and a little sweet.

recipes.name: Café Viennois
ingredients: Cold skim milk, up to the minimum line on the jug
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to LUNGO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a lungo cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour cold skim milk up to the minimum fill line into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to EXTRA-THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Spoon the foam generously over the coffee.
Grate a little dark chocolate on top.
recipes.adaptation: Nespresso calls for very cold 0% milk for a dense foam. The Pro's EXTRA-THICK FROTH preset is made for exactly this.
recipes.blurb: A lungo topped with cold frothed milk and finished with grated dark chocolate.

recipes.name: Americano
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to AMERICANO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a mug under the spout and press START BREW.
When it finishes, top up with HOT WATER to your taste.
tips: Press the strength button for a stronger (2:1) or longer (4:1) cup.
recipes.blurb: Espresso topped up with hot water, so it's as long as a cup of coffee but with espresso flavor.

recipes.name: Americano con Crema
steps: Pour 2 tbsp cold milk (the jug's minimum line if 2 tbsp is too little) into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to EXTRA-THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Let the foam rest for 1 to 2 minutes while you brew.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Add orange syrup to the mug.
Place a mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Add ¼ cup hot water from the hot water spout and stir.
Top with a few spoonfuls of the milk foam and sprinkle with sugar if you like.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks blends the milk for 2 minutes to make a stiff foam. The EXTRA-THICK FROTH preset replaces the blender.

subRecipes.name: Orange syrup
ingredients: Peel or zest of ½ orange
steps: Simmer the water, sugar and orange peel over medium-high heat, stirring now and then, for about 5 minutes until the sugar dissolves.
Let it cool, then strain into a jar.

recipes.blurb: An americano with homemade orange syrup and a splash of milk. Citrusy and smooth.

recipes.name: Iced Americano
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a glass with ½ cup ice.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Taste, then add up to 2 tbsp cold water if you want it milder.
tips: Add a splash of oat milk, simple syrup, vanilla syrup or demerara syrup if you like.
recipes.blurb: Espresso over ice with a splash of cold water. Clean, crisp and refreshing.

recipes.name: Sparkling Long Black Over Ice
steps: Put 4 ice cubes in a tall glass and pour in the sparkling water. Give it a stir.
Fit the Single basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Add the coconut syrup if you like.
recipes.adaptation: Nespresso uses a 25 ml extraction. The Pro's Single basket shot is the closest match.
recipes.blurb: Espresso poured over ice and sparkling water, with an optional touch of coconut syrup. Light and fizzy.

recipes.name: Iced Hazelnut Latte
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a 12 oz glass with ice and add the hazelnut syrup.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour in the milk and stir.
recipes.blurb: Cold-pressed espresso, hazelnut syrup and cold milk over ice. Nutty and smooth.

recipes.name: Brown Sugar Oat Milk Shaken Latte
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Put the brown sugar and a handful of ice in a cocktail shaker.
Place the shaker under the spout and press START BREW.
Shake hard for 15 seconds.
Pour into a 10 oz glass and top with the oat milk.
recipes.blurb: Cold-pressed espresso shaken with brown sugar and ice, then topped with oat milk.

recipes.name: Iced Dirty Chai
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a 16 oz glass with ice.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Add the milk and chai concentrate and stir.
recipes.blurb: Iced chai latte with a shot of cold-pressed espresso. Spiced, creamy and strong.

recipes.name: Espresso Martini
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a cocktail shaker with ice.
Place the shaker under the spout and press START BREW.
Add the simple syrup, vodka and coffee liqueur.
Shake hard for 10 seconds and strain into a martini glass.
Float 3 espresso beans on top.
tips: Boozy cold foam version (Ninja): froth 2 oz heavy cream with ½ oz Irish cream and 1 tsp vanilla syrup on COLD FOAM, swap the simple syrup for 2 oz Irish cream, use 1 oz vodka, then spoon the foam over the strained martini.
recipes.blurb: A cocktail of cold-pressed espresso, vodka and coffee liqueur, shaken until frothy. Contains alcohol.

recipes.name: Iced Chocolate Strawberry Latte
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a 16 oz glass with ice and drizzle 1 tbsp strawberry syrup and the chocolate syrup over the ice.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the heavy cream (to the 2 oz line) into the milk jug, then add the other 2 tbsp strawberry syrup. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Stir the milk into the espresso, then top with the strawberry cold foam.

subRecipes.name: Strawberry syrup (make the night before)
steps: Stir the strawberries and sugar together and refrigerate overnight.
Strain. Keeps in the fridge for up to 1 week.

recipes.blurb: Iced latte layered with strawberry and chocolate syrups, cream and milk. Like chocolate-covered strawberries.

recipes.name: Iced Caramel Macchiato
steps: Pour the vanilla syrup into a 16 oz glass, add the cold milk, then fill with ice to ½ inch below the rim.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Let the espresso layer on top, then finish with a crosshatch of caramel sauce.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks pours hot espresso shots. Cold-pressed keeps the ice from melting and gives cleaner layers.

subRecipes.name: Vanilla syrup
ingredients: 1 vanilla bean, split (or 1½ tbsp vanilla extract)
steps: Bring the sugar, water and vanilla bean to a boil, then simmer 5 minutes.
Cool, then remove the bean (or stir in the extract once cooled).

subRecipes.name: Caramel sauce
steps: Heat everything in a small saucepan over medium-low for 1 minute.
Turn to low and simmer 10 minutes.
Cool before using. Keeps 1 week in the fridge.

recipes.blurb: Vanilla milk over ice with cold-pressed espresso poured on top and a caramel drizzle.

recipes.name: Espresso Tonic
ingredients: Double shot of cold-pressed espresso (about 2 oz)
steps: Fill an 8 oz glass with ice and pour in the tonic water.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a small cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the espresso gently over the tonic so it floats.
Run the citrus wedge around the rim and drop it in.
tips: Always tonic first, espresso second, or it foams over.
recipes.adaptation: The original cools a hot double shot. Cold-pressed is already cool, so there's no wait.
recipes.blurb: Cold-pressed espresso floated on tonic water and ice with a citrus wedge. Bitter, bubbly and refreshing.

recipes.name: Shakerato with Sweet Cream
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a cocktail shaker with ice and add the simple syrup.
Place the shaker under the spout and press START BREW.
Shake hard for 20 to 30 seconds until foamy.
Strain into a glass and spoon the foam from the shaker on top.
Add sweet cream syrup to taste.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks uses 4 oz chilled drip coffee. A Luxe-basket cold-pressed quad (about 4 oz) is the traditional Italian way and needs no chilling.

subRecipes.name: Sweet cream syrup
steps: Warm the condensed milk and half-and-half over low heat, stirring often, for 5 to 10 minutes.
Cool completely. Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.blurb: Italian iced coffee: a quad shot shaken hard with ice and syrup until foamy, with sweet cream.

recipes.name: Café au Lait
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to CLASSIC and press SIZE until 6 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a 12 oz cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour 5 oz cold whole milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the frothed milk into the coffee.
recipes.blurb: The French breakfast coffee: brewed coffee with an equal pour of hot steamed milk.

recipes.name: Café de Olla
ingredients: 1 heaping tbsp piloncillo or dark brown sugar
½ small cinnamon stick (Ceylon if you can), broken up
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to CLASSIC and press SIZE until 10 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Scatter the broken cinnamon stick over the grounds.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Put the piloncillo in a 12 oz mug.
Place the mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir until the piloncillo dissolves.
recipes.adaptation: Saveur simmers 8 cups of water with the coffee, piloncillo and cinnamon in a clay pot. This is a one-mug version: the cinnamon brews with the grounds and the piloncillo melts in the cup. Use a dark roast.
recipes.blurb: Mexican pot coffee: dark coffee sweetened with piloncillo (raw cane sugar) and warmed with cinnamon.

recipes.name: Salted Caramel Apple Coffee
ingredients: Whipped cream, caramel drizzle, a dash of cinnamon, a rolled wafer cookie (any or all)
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to CLASSIC and press SIZE until 6 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Add the syrup to a 12 oz mug.
Place the mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir the syrup into the coffee.
Pour 4 oz cold whole milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Add the milk, then top with whipped cream, caramel, cinnamon or a rolled wafer cookie.

subRecipes.name: Salted caramel apple syrup (keeps 7 days)
steps: Simmer the brown sugar and water over low heat until the sugar dissolves.
Add the cinnamon, cloves, salt and applesauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Strain through a fine-mesh strainer, stirring gently.
Stir in the caramel sauce while warm. Refrigerate.

recipes.blurb: Coffee and milk with a homemade salted caramel apple syrup, topped with whipped cream and caramel.

recipes.name: South Indian Cardamom Coffee
steps: Pour ¾ cup cold low-fat milk into the milk jug, then add the crushed cardamom seeds. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to STEAMED MILK and press START FROTH.
Let the milk sit with the cardamom for a couple of minutes while you brew.
Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to CLASSIC and press SIZE until 6 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a large mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the milk through a small strainer into the coffee to catch the seeds.
Sweeten to taste.
recipes.adaptation: Sunset simmers the milk and cardamom for 5 minutes and drips 3 tbsp of fine-ground coffee with ⅔ cup water. The STEAMED MILK preset plus a short steep, and a 6 oz CLASSIC brew, match it.
recipes.blurb: South Indian-style milky coffee scented with crushed cardamom and sweetened to taste.

recipes.name: Irish Coffee with Cold Foam
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RICH and press SIZE until 10 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Put the brown sugar in a 16 oz glass mug.
Place the mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir in the whiskey.
Pour the milk and heavy cream into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Spoon the cold foam over the hot coffee.
recipes.blurb: Hot coffee with brown sugar and Irish whiskey under a cap of cold cream foam. Contains alcohol.

recipes.name: Mexican-Spiced Coffee with Chocolate Cold Foam
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RICH and press SIZE until 10 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Sprinkle the cinnamon, chili powder and cayenne over the grounds and tap to spread them evenly.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a 14 oz mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the heavy cream into the milk jug, then add the powdered sugar and cocoa. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Spoon the chocolate cold foam onto the coffee.
tips: Make it iced: choose COLD-PRESSED and brew over ice.
recipes.blurb: Coffee spiced with cinnamon, chili and cayenne, topped with a chocolate cold foam. Warm with a little heat.

recipes.name: Hong Kong Yuenyeung (Coffee Milk Tea)
ingredients: 1½ tbsp loose black tea (or 3 tea bags, strings removed)
steps: Bring the water and tea to a rolling boil in a small pot, then simmer hard for about 5 minutes until dark.
Take it off the heat and stir in the evaporated and condensed milk.
Heat again over medium-high until steaming, about 3 minutes, then strain into a teapot.
Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RICH and press SIZE until 8 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a carafe under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir the coffee into the milk tea and pour into two mugs. Or pour over ice for a cold version.
recipes.adaptation: Saveur's recipe serves 4 with 2 cups of hot black coffee. This is halved, and RICH gives the strong coffee the drink needs.
recipes.blurb: A Hong Kong favorite: half coffee, half strong milk tea, made creamy with evaporated and condensed milk.

recipes.name: Café Brûlot
ingredients: Two 18 oz batches of brewed French roast coffee, kept hot
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RICH and press SIZE until 18 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a carafe under the spout and press START BREW.
Brew a second 18 oz batch and keep both hot.
Peel one orange in a single long spiral, stud it with the cloves and spear one end on a fork.
Cut the lemon peel and the second orange's peel into ¼-inch twists.
Warm the peels, cinnamon sticks, brandy and orange liqueur in a small pot over low heat for 3 to 5 minutes.
Pour into a heatproof metal bowl. Take a ladleful and carefully light it.
Hold the clove-studded spiral over the bowl and slowly pour the flaming liquor down it so the flame spirals into the bowl.
Slowly pour in the hot coffee while stirring to put out the flame. Ladle into demitasse cups.
tips: Do the flaming part away from anything that can catch, with a lid nearby.
recipes.adaptation: The original calls for 6 cups of French roast. Two 18 oz RICH brews make about the same amount.
recipes.blurb: A New Orleans party coffee with citrus peel, cloves, cinnamon, brandy and orange liqueur. Contains alcohol.

recipes.name: Honey Coffee
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RICH and press SIZE until 8 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a carafe under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour ¼ cup cold whole milk (fill to the minimum line if needed) into the milk jug, then add the honey, cinnamon and nutmeg. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to STEAMED MILK and press START FROTH.
Stir the hot spiced milk and the vanilla into the coffee and pour into mugs.
recipes.adaptation: Taste of Home warms everything together in a pan and serves 4. This is halved, and the STEAMED MILK preset warms the milk, honey and spice in one go.
recipes.blurb: Strong coffee with milk, honey, vanilla and a pinch of cinnamon and nutmeg.

recipes.name: Iced Coffee with Salted Caramel Cold Foam
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to OVER ICE and press SIZE until 10 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a 16 oz glass with ice (take out the center drip tray if it doesn't fit).
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the cream and milk into the milk jug, then add the caramel syrup and salt. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Spoon the foam over the coffee.
tips: Make it hot: choose CLASSIC, froth with THIN FROTH and skip the ice.
recipes.blurb: Iced coffee topped with a sweet and salty caramel cold foam.

recipes.name: Iced Coffee with Peppermint Cold Foam
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to OVER ICE and press SIZE until 10 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a 16 oz glass with ice.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the cream and milk into the milk jug, then add the peppermint syrup. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Spoon the foam over the coffee.
tips: Make it hot: choose CLASSIC and skip the ice.
recipes.blurb: Iced coffee topped with a cool peppermint cold foam.

recipes.name: Vietnamese-Style Iced Coffee
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to OVER ICE and press SIZE until 10 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a cocktail shaker with ice and add the condensed milk.
Place the shaker under the spout and press START BREW.
Shake for 10 seconds and pour into a 16 oz glass.
recipes.blurb: Strong coffee and sweetened condensed milk over ice. Bold, sweet and creamy.

recipes.name: Thai Iced Coffee
ingredients: 6 oz over-ice coffee, from Thai coffee powder or a dark roast
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to OVER ICE and press SIZE until 6 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Stir the condensed milk, sugar and salt together in a mixing glass.
Place the mixing glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir until dissolved. It should taste a little too strong and too sweet, because the ice will soften it.
Fill a 16 oz glass all the way with ice and pour the coffee over it.
Drizzle the evaporated milk on top so it cascades down, then stir before drinking.
tips: Thai coffee powders (like Oliang) often include roasted grains. If yours does, it won't work in the grinder: brew it in a French press with ¾ cup hot water for 5 minutes instead.
recipes.adaptation: Pailin steeps 3 tbsp Thai coffee powder in ¾ cup off-the-boil water. The Pro's OVER ICE program brews a strong 6 oz from whole dark-roast beans instead.
recipes.blurb: Strong coffee sweetened with condensed milk and sugar, poured over ice and topped with evaporated milk.

recipes.name: Japanese Iced Coffee
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to OVER ICE and press SIZE until 12 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a carafe about a third full with ice.
Place a carafe or large glass jug under the spout and press START BREW.
Swirl until chilled, then pour over fresh ice in two glasses.
recipes.adaptation: Nami pour-overs 30 g of beans with 370 ml of 205°F water by hand. OVER ICE runs the same hot, flash-chilled method automatically.
recipes.blurb: Light-roast coffee brewed hot straight onto ice, so it chills instantly and keeps its bright flavor.

recipes.name: Iced Cinnamon Honey Coffee
ingredients: Splash of milk of your choice
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to OVER ICE and press SIZE until 8 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a 16 oz glass with ice.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Add a splash of milk and some cinnamon honey syrup, stir, and adjust to taste.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks brews double-strength coffee in a press. OVER ICE already brews double-strong for pouring over ice.

subRecipes.name: Cinnamon honey syrup
steps: Bring the water, honey and cinnamon sticks to a boil.
Turn to low and simmer 10 minutes.
Take it off the heat, stir in the vanilla and cool completely. Keep in the fridge.

recipes.blurb: Iced coffee sweetened with a homemade cinnamon honey syrup and a splash of milk.

recipes.name: Almond Milk Caramel Cold Brew
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD BREW and press SIZE until 10 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a 12 oz glass with ice and add the caramel syrup.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Add the almond milk and stir.
tips: Make it hot: choose RICH and skip the ice.
recipes.blurb: Cold brew over ice with caramel syrup and a splash of almond milk.

recipes.name: Cold Brew with Cold Foam
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD BREW and press SIZE until 12 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a medium glass with ice.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the cream and milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Spoon the cold foam over the cold brew.
tips: For a thicker foam, use 3 oz heavy cream and no milk.
recipes.adaptation: Ninja's UK guide uses size M (about 10 oz).
recipes.blurb: Smooth cold brew over ice, topped with a thick layer of frothed cold cream.

recipes.name: Vanilla Sweet Cream Cold Brew
steps: Stir the half-and-half and 1 tbsp vanilla syrup together to make the sweet cream. Keep it cold.
Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD BREW and press SIZE until 8 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Add 2 tbsp vanilla syrup and 1 cup ice to a 16 oz glass.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the sweet cream over the top and watch it swirl down.
tips: Starbucks-style sweet cream: 6 oz heavy cream, 3 oz 2% milk and 1 oz vanilla syrup. Keeps 4 days.
recipes.blurb: Vanilla-sweetened cold brew with a float of vanilla sweet cream on top.

recipes.name: Salted Caramel Cream Cold Brew
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD BREW and press SIZE until 8 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a 16 oz glass with ice and add half the caramel syrup.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir.

Pour the heavy cream (fill to the jug's minimum line, doubling the cream if needed) into the milk jug, then add the rest of the caramel syrup. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Pour the foam over the cold brew and sprinkle with the salt.
recipes.adaptation: Arman whips the foam with a handheld frother. The Pro's COLD FOAM preset does the same. Half-and-half won't hold a foam, so use heavy cream.
recipes.blurb: Cold brew with caramel, topped with a sweet and salty caramel cream.

recipes.name: Pumpkin Cream Cold Brew
ingredients: ½ cup half-and-half or heavy cream
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD BREW and press SIZE until 12 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a carafe of ice under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour the cream into the milk jug, then add the vanilla syrup, pumpkin purée, cinnamon and nutmeg. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Fill two glasses with ice and pour 6 oz of cold brew into each.
Top with the pumpkin cream.
recipes.adaptation: Tasting Table steeps cold brew for 12 hours. The Pro's COLD BREW program makes it in minutes, and COLD FOAM replaces the immersion blender. Heavy cream foams best.
recipes.blurb: Vanilla cold brew topped with a pumpkin spice cold foam. A fall favorite.

recipes.name: Mocha Whipped Iced Coffee
steps: Place an 8 oz mug under the hot water spout.
Press HOT WATER, set the temperature to HIGH and the size to 6 oz, then press START.
Pour 2 tbsp of the hot water into the milk jug and add the sugar, instant coffee and cocoa. (You won't need the rest of the water.)
Set the jug on the frothing platform, press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Pour the milk into a 12 oz glass of ice and spoon the whipped mocha on top.
recipes.blurb: Whipped instant coffee and cocoa spooned over cold milk and ice. A chocolate take on dalgona coffee.

recipes.name: Matcha Latte
ingredients: ½ to 1 tsp matcha powder, sifted
¼ cup coconut milk (light or full-fat)
Maple syrup or honey, to taste (optional)
steps: Sift the matcha into a large mug.
Place a small measuring cup under the hot water spout.
Press HOT WATER, set the temperature to LOW and the size to the smallest size, then press START.
Pour ¼ cup of the hot water over the matcha and whisk briskly up and down for about 30 seconds until frothy.
Pour ¼ cup coconut milk (fill to the minimum line if needed) into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until PLANT-BASED lights up, turn the froth dial to STEAMED MILK and press START FROTH.
Add the warm milk to the mug and whisk again until combined.
Sweeten to taste.
tips: Whisk up and down, not in circles, for the best foam.
Very hot water makes matcha bitter, which is why we use the LOW setting.
recipes.blurb: Whisked Japanese green tea powder with frothed coconut milk, sweetened to taste. No coffee.

recipes.name: London Fog Latte
steps: Put the tea bags in an 8 oz mug.
Place the mug under the hot water spout.
Press HOT WATER, set the temperature to HIGH and the size to the smallest size, stopping at ½ cup, then press START.
Steep for 5 minutes, then remove the tea bags and stir in the sugar.
Pour ½ cup cold milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour most of the milk into the tea, stir in the cream and vanilla, then add the last of the milk and foam.
tips: Start with 1 tsp sugar if you like it less sweet.
Use decaf Earl Grey for evenings, or pour over ice for an iced fog.
recipes.blurb: Earl Grey tea with frothed milk, a little sugar and vanilla. No coffee.

recipes.name: Classic Hot Toddy
steps: Place a mug under the hot water spout.
Press HOT WATER, set the temperature to HIGH and the size to 6 oz, then press START.
Add the whiskey, 2 tsp honey and 2 tsp lemon juice and stir until the honey dissolves.
Taste and add up to 1 more tsp of honey or lemon.
Garnish with a lemon round and a cinnamon stick.
tips: Swap the whiskey for brandy or dark rum.
Steep a black or green tea bag in the water for 2 to 3 minutes first.
recipes.adaptation: The original simmers water in a kettle; 6 oz on HIGH from the hot water spout is about ¾ cup.
recipes.blurb: A warm drink of whiskey, honey and lemon in hot water. Contains alcohol, no coffee.

recipes.name: Café Cubano
steps: Put the sugar in a small metal pitcher or mug.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a second small cup under the spout and press START BREW.
As soon as the first few drops come out, take 1 tsp of the espresso and pour it onto the sugar.
With the back of the spoon, grind the sugar and coffee against the side of the pitcher for 60 seconds until it's a smooth, pale paste.
When the shot finishes, pour it very slowly into the sugar paste and stir gently. A light-tan foam (the espumita) rises to the top.
Pour into espresso cups so each gets a layer of foam.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks brews it in a stovetop moka pot. The Pro's double shot replaces the moka pot; the sugar-whipping is the same.
recipes.blurb: A Cuban shot of dark espresso whipped with sugar into a sweet, foamy crema.

recipes.name: Ristretto Almond Lemon Brûlée
ingredients: About ¾ tsp (3 g) brown sugar
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RISTRETTO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a small clear glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour 3½ oz cold low-fat milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THICK FROTH and press START FROTH.
Spoon the hot foam onto the ristretto.
Sprinkle the brown sugar over the foam and caramelize it with a kitchen torch, like a crème brûlée.
Scatter the toasted almonds and lemon peel on top.
tips: No torch? Skip the caramelizing and just sprinkle the sugar on; it's still lovely.
recipes.adaptation: Nespresso uses a 25 ml capsule and the Aeroccino cappuccino setting. THICK FROTH is the Pro's cappuccino foam.
recipes.blurb: A ristretto with frothed milk, caramelized brown sugar, toasted almonds and lemon peel. Like a crème brûlée.

recipes.name: Stockholm Spice Lungo
ingredients: About 1 tsp (5 g) freshly grated nutmeg
steps: Put the cinnamon, nutmeg, clove and sugar (if using) in the cup. Or tie the spices in a paper tea filter for a cleaner cup.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to LUNGO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place the cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir and let it sit for a moment before drinking.
recipes.blurb: A dark lungo spiced with cinnamon, nutmeg and clove, lightly sweetened.

recipes.name: Spiced Americano with Cinnamon Whipped Cream
steps: Whip the cream to soft peaks, add the powdered sugar and whip until stiff.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a 6 to 8 oz cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Add 2 oz hot water from the hot water spout and 2 tbsp spiced syrup, and stir.
Top with a dollop of whipped cream and dust with cinnamon.
recipes.adaptation: Giada's version makes 4 cups from 1 cup of espresso and 1 cup of boiling water. This is one cup, using the Pro's double shot and hot water spout.

subRecipes.name: Spiced syrup (enough for about 8 drinks)
steps: Bring the water and sugar to a boil over medium heat, then turn to low.
Add the spices and simmer 5 minutes. Cool and keep in the fridge.

recipes.blurb: An americano with homemade spiced syrup, topped with cinnamon whipped cream.

recipes.name: Red Eye
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a large 16 oz mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Tap the used grounds out of the portafilter.
Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to CLASSIC and press SIZE until 10 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place the same mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Drink it black, or add milk to taste.
tips: For a 'black eye', use a quad shot (Luxe basket) instead of a double.
recipes.adaptation: KitchenAid's machine brews a double shot and then drip coffee into the same mug. The Pro does both: espresso first, then a CLASSIC brew on top.
recipes.blurb: Brewed coffee with a shot of espresso added for an extra kick.

recipes.name: Iced Coconut Coffee
steps: Put the coconut sugar and crushed ice in a glass, pour in the coconut milk and stir well.
Fit the Single basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a small cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir the cold water into the espresso, then pour it over the coconut milk and watch it swirl.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks brews a capsule shot with 60 ml extra water and chills it. A cold-pressed single shot plus 60 ml cold water gives the same chilled americano with no wait.
recipes.blurb: Cold-pressed espresso with coconut sugar and coconut milk over crushed ice. Light and tropical.

recipes.name: Iced Honey Oat Coffee
ingredients: ⅓ cup (80 ml) unsweetened oat milk
steps: Fit the Single basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD-PRESSED.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a glass with the ice.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Add the cold water.
Drizzle in the honey slowly and stir well so it dissolves.
Top with the oat milk.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks brews a capsule americano over ice. A cold-pressed single shot plus 60 ml cold water matches it, and the honey still dissolves if you stir well.
recipes.blurb: Cold-pressed espresso sweetened with honey and topped with oat milk over ice.

recipes.name: Cinnamon Mocha Coffee
ingredients: ⅛ tsp + a pinch ground cinnamon
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to CLASSIC and press SIZE until 8 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Sprinkle the cinnamon evenly over the grounds.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a carafe under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour ¼ cup cold 2% milk (fill to the jug's minimum line if needed) into the milk jug, then add the sugar, cocoa and vanilla. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to STEAMED MILK and press START FROTH.
Pour the hot chocolate milk into a mug, then add the cinnamon coffee.
Add a cinnamon stick and whipped cream if you like.
recipes.adaptation: Taste of Home brews 4 cups with the cinnamon in the basket and heats the chocolate milk in a pan. This is one mug, with STEAMED MILK doing the pan's job.
recipes.blurb: Brewed coffee with cocoa, cinnamon, vanilla and milk. A quick homemade mocha.

recipes.name: Bulletproof Coffee
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to CLASSIC and press SIZE until 8 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a blender-safe jug under the spout and press START BREW.
Add the butter and MCT oil and blend for 30 seconds until frothy.
Pour into a mug.
tips: No blender: melt the butter in the mug, add the rest and froth with a handheld frother.
Add 1 tsp vanilla extract or a pinch of cinnamon for flavor.
recipes.blurb: Coffee blended with butter and MCT oil until creamy and foamy. Rich, with no sugar or milk.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Egg Coffee (Cà Phê Trứng)
ingredients: ¼ cup (60 ml) sweetened condensed milk
½ cup (4 oz) brewed dark-roast coffee
Ground cinnamon or cocoa, to top
steps: Beat the egg yolks, condensed milk and vanilla with a hand mixer for about 5 minutes, until thick and very pale. A drizzle should hold its shape on top for a moment.
Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RICH and press SIZE until 6 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a cup under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour ½ cup of the hot coffee into a small heatproof glass.
Spoon the egg cream slowly over the back of a spoon onto the coffee so it forms a thick separate layer.
Dust with cinnamon or cocoa and serve right away.
tips: Use pasteurized eggs, since the yolks aren't cooked.
A milk frother won't whip it thick enough; use a hand mixer.
Hanoi cafés set the glass in a bowl of hot water to keep it warm.
recipes.adaptation: Tara drips coarse Vietnamese coffee through a phin and says ½ cup strong brewed coffee works too. The Pro's RICH brew gives that strong coffee; use a dark roast.
recipes.blurb: A Hanoi specialty: dark coffee topped with a thick, custard-like foam of whipped egg yolk and condensed milk.

recipes.name: Caramel Mocha
steps: Whip the heavy cream until it thickens, add the powdered sugar and a few drops of the vanilla, and whip to stiff peaks.
Pour the half-and-half (fill to the jug's minimum line if needed) into the milk jug, then add the cocoa. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to STEAMED MILK and press START FROTH.
Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to RICH and press SIZE until 8 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Add the caramel syrup and the rest of the vanilla to the mug.
Place a 14 oz mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir in the hot cocoa milk.
Top with the whipped cream and a drizzle of butterscotch.
recipes.adaptation: Taste of Home makes 6 servings on the stove and says to divide by four for a smaller batch. This is that small batch in one mug, with STEAMED MILK warming the cocoa and half-and-half.
recipes.blurb: Coffee with cocoa, half-and-half and caramel, topped with vanilla whipped cream and caramel drizzle.

recipes.name: Mazagran (Coffee Lemonade)
ingredients: About 3½ oz (100 g) ice for the carafe
steps: In a carafe with about 3½ oz of ice, stir the sugar, lemon juice and water together to make a strong lemonade.
Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to OVER ICE and press SIZE until 10 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place the carafe under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir, then pour into a 12 oz or bigger glass of fresh ice.
recipes.adaptation: Seattle Coffee Gear brews 25 g of light roast in an AeroPress with 300 g of water straight onto the lemonade. The Pro's OVER ICE brew lands on the lemonade the same way.
recipes.blurb: Iced coffee lemonade: coffee with fresh lemon juice and sugar over ice. Tart, sweet and refreshing.

recipes.name: Iced Hazelnut Coffee
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to OVER ICE and press SIZE until 6 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a tall glass with the ice and add the hazelnut syrup.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Top with the milk and stir until the syrup is mixed in.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks pours 4 oz of brewed Pike Place over ice. The Pro's smallest OVER ICE size, 6 oz, is brewed strong for ice, so it lands about the same.
recipes.blurb: Iced coffee with a little hazelnut syrup and milk.

recipes.name: Cold Brew with Salted Honey Cold Foam
ingredients: ¼ cup skim milk (or a barista-style plant milk)
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD BREW and press SIZE until 8 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Fill a 16 oz glass with ice.
Place the glass under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir in about half the honey syrup.
Pour ¼ cup cold skim milk (fill to the jug's minimum line if needed) into the milk jug, then add the rest of the honey syrup and the salt. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to COLD FOAM and press START FROTH.
Pour or spoon the salted honey foam on top.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks mixes 4 oz cold brew concentrate with 4 oz water. The Pro's COLD BREW program brews it ready to drink, so use 8 oz straight. Their honey syrup recipe is on a separate page, so this is a simple 1:1 honey syrup.

subRecipes.name: Honey syrup
steps: Stir the honey into hot water from the hot water spout until dissolved. Keeps 2 weeks in the fridge.

recipes.blurb: Cold brew sweetened with honey syrup and topped with a salted honey cold foam.

recipes.name: Cold Brew Coconut Chocolate Milkshake
steps: Fit the Luxe basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to COLD BREW and press SIZE until 6 oz lights up.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND.
Give the portafilter a gentle shake to level the grounds, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a blender jar with a couple of ice cubes under the spout and press START BREW.
Add the coconut ice cream and chocolate chips and blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and top with whipped cream and toasted coconut.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks uses 4 oz of cold brew concentrate. The Pro's smallest cold brew is 6 oz of ready-to-drink cold brew; brewing onto a couple of ice cubes keeps it cold and thick.
recipes.blurb: A milkshake of cold brew, coconut ice cream and chocolate, topped with whipped cream and toasted coconut.

recipes.name: Honey Citrus Mint Tea (Medicine Ball)
ingredients: 1 green tea bag (a mint green tea is closest)
steps: Put both tea bags in a large mug.
Place the mug under the hot water spout.
Press HOT WATER, set the temperature to HIGH and the size to 10 oz, then press START.
Steep for 5 minutes while you warm the lemonade in the microwave for about 1 minute.
Remove the tea bags, stir in the honey and the warm lemonade.
tips: Add a drop of peppermint extract for the Starbucks peppermint version.
Swap the lemonade for the juice of a small lemon plus a little more honey.
recipes.adaptation: Jee simmers the water, lemonade and tea together for 5 minutes. Here the hot water spout steeps the tea and the lemonade is warmed separately.
recipes.blurb: A soothing tea of green and peach teas with warm lemonade and honey. No coffee.

recipes.name: Creamy Hot Cocoa
steps: Put the cocoa, sugar and salt in a mug.
Add 4 tsp hot water from the hot water spout (HIGH) and stir into a smooth, glossy paste.
Pour 1 cup cold whole milk into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to STEAMED MILK and press START FROTH.
Pour the hot milk into the mug while stirring, then stir in the vanilla.
Top with whipped cream if you like.
recipes.adaptation: Lauren makes 4 mugs on the stove and simmers the cocoa paste for 2 minutes. This is one mug, with the hot water spout for the paste and STEAMED MILK for the milk.
recipes.blurb: Classic hot chocolate made with cocoa, sugar, vanilla and frothed whole milk. No coffee.

recipes.name: Vanilla Latte
ingredients: 4 oz (½ cup) whole milk or oat milk
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place a 10 oz mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Pour 4 oz cold milk (fill to the minimum line if needed) into the milk jug, then add the vanilla syrup. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY (or PLANT-BASED) lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the milk into the center of the espresso, finishing with a thin layer of foam.
tips: Make it iced: brew on COLD-PRESSED over a glass of ice, stir in the syrup and pour in cold milk.
recipes.adaptation: Sonja steams the syrup with the milk, so the Pro's jug does the same job.

subRecipes.name: Vanilla syrup
steps: Warm the sugar and water in a small pan over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes, stirring until the sugar dissolves. Don't let it simmer.
Take it off the heat, stir in the vanilla and let it cool. Keeps in the fridge for about a month.

recipes.blurb: Espresso and steamed milk sweetened with a little vanilla syrup. The most popular flavored latte.

recipes.name: White Chocolate Mocha
ingredients: 4 tbsp white chocolate chips or chopped white chocolate
steps: Put the white chocolate in a 12 oz mug and warm it in the microwave in 15-second bursts until soft.
Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Place the mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir the hot espresso into the white chocolate until smooth.
Pour 1 cup cold 2% milk (up to the LATTE line) into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the frothed milk into the mug and top with whipped cream.
recipes.adaptation: Starbucks uses a single 1 oz shot. A double stands up better to the sweet white chocolate. Use the Single basket for theirs.
recipes.blurb: Espresso and steamed milk with melted white chocolate, topped with whipped cream. Sweet and creamy.

recipes.name: Gingerbread Latte
ingredients: 4 oz (½ cup) whole milk or oat milk
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Put the gingerbread syrup in a 10 oz mug.
Place a 10 oz mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir the syrup into the espresso.
Pour 4 oz cold milk (fill to the minimum line if needed) into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY (or PLANT-BASED) lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the milk into the center of the espresso, finishing with foam, and dust with cinnamon.

subRecipes.name: Gingerbread syrup
steps: Toast the cinnamon and allspice in a small pan over medium-low heat for 2 minutes.
Add the ginger, water, brown sugar and vanilla. Keep at a low simmer for 15 to 20 minutes.
Strain and cool. Keeps in the fridge for about a month.

recipes.blurb: A holiday latte with gingerbread syrup (ginger, cinnamon and molasses) and a dusting of cinnamon.

recipes.name: Lavender Latte
ingredients: 4 oz (½ cup) whole milk or oat milk
steps: Fit the Double basket into the portafilter, put the dosing funnel on and set it in the grinding cradle.
Turn the center dial to ESPRESSO.
Turn the grind dial to the number Barista Assist recommends, then press START GRIND. The built-in scale doses by weight.
Pull the tamping lever down firmly twice, then lift off the funnel.
Lock the portafilter into the brew head.
Put the lavender syrup in a 10 oz mug.
Place a 10 oz mug under the spout and press START BREW.
Stir the syrup into the espresso.
Pour 4 oz cold milk (fill to the minimum line if needed) into the milk jug. Set the jug on the frothing platform with the whisk inside.
Press MILK TYPE until DAIRY (or PLANT-BASED) lights up, turn the froth dial to THIN FROTH and press START FROTH.
Pour the milk into the center of the espresso, finishing with foam. Scatter a few lavender buds on top.

subRecipes.name: Lavender syrup
steps: Bring the sugar, water and lavender to a simmer, stirring until the sugar dissolves.
Turn off the heat, let it steep 20 minutes, then strain into a jar. Keeps in the fridge for about a month.

recipes.blurb: A latte sweetened with homemade lavender syrup. Lightly floral and smooth.

recipes.name: Caramelized Honey Latte
ingredients: ½ cup honey, plus a drizzle to finish
steps: Simmer the honey, water and lemon juice in a small pan over medium heat, stirring.
Once it bubbles, stop stirring and let it cook 1 to 2 minutes until it darkens and smells nutty.
